title: What I learned from six months of being stupid on purpose
title_zh: 我刻意犯蠢六个月学到的东西

paragraphs.en: Writing October 21, 2026 · 13 min read What I learned from six months of being stupid on purpose Feeling stupid often, and in new ways
paragraphs.zh: 写作 2026年10月21日 · 13 分钟阅读 故意装傻六个月，我学到了什么 经常感到愚蠢，而且是以新的方式

paragraphs.en: This reflection isn’t only for myself, but for anyone looking to improve at feeling uncomfortable with new experiences, especially when there’s very little around to give you comfort. Whether you’re a technical or non-technical reader - I’m sure lots of people can/will relate.
paragraphs.zh: 这篇反思不仅写给我自己，也写给任何想在面对新体验带来的不适时有所进步的人，尤其是当周围几乎没有什么能给你安慰的时候。 无论你是技术读者还是非技术读者——我相信很多人都能产生共鸣或将产生共鸣。

sents.en: This reflection isn’t only for myself, but for anyone looking to improve at feeling uncomfortable with new experiences, especially when there’s very little around to give you comfort.
sents.zh: 这篇反思不仅写给我自己，也写给任何想在面对新体验带来的不适时有所进步的人，尤其是当周围几乎没有什么能给你安慰的时候。

sents.en: Whether you’re a technical or non-technical reader - I’m sure lots of people can/will relate.
sents.zh: 无论你是技术读者还是非技术读者——我相信很多人都能产生共鸣或将产生共鸣。

paragraphs.en: I hope the lessons I speak about can help anyone looking to tackle or learn something new.
paragraphs.zh: 我希望我所讲述的经验教训能够帮助任何想要攻克难题或学习新事物的人。

paragraphs.en: This is also the first post to my blog, where I will regularly document my thoughts and experiences as I navigate my life, projects, and career. I don’t consider myself to be an expert in any aspect.
paragraphs.zh: 这也是我博客的第一篇文章，我将在其中定期记录我在生活、项目和职业生涯中的思考与经历。 我并不认为自己在任何方面都是专家。

sents.en: This is also the first post to my blog, where I will regularly document my thoughts and experiences as I navigate my life, projects, and career.
sents.zh: 这也是我博客的第一篇文章，我将在其中定期记录我在生活、项目和职业生涯中的思考与经历。

sents.en: I don’t consider myself to be an expert in any aspect.
sents.zh: 我并不认为自己在任何方面都是专家。

paragraphs.en: I graduated from Loyola U Chicago back in May of this year (2026) with a degree in Finance. I also spent four different summers working at a large healthcare company as a Financial Planning and Analysis Intern. Despite how amazing those experiences were, they also made me feel like my fate had already been decided, fostering an unhealthy perspective where careers outside of my “one-way path” were a waste of all the time I had invested.
paragraphs.zh: 我于今年（2026 年）5 月从芝加哥洛约拉大学毕业，获得金融学学位。 我还连续四个暑假在一家大型医疗健康公司担任财务规划与分析实习生。 尽管这些经历非常美好，但它们也让我觉得自己的命运早已注定，养成了一种不健康的心态，认为偏离这条“单行道”的任何职业道路，都是对我投入的所有时间的一种浪费。

sents.en: I graduated from Loyola U Chicago back in May of this year (2026) with a degree in Finance.
sents.zh: 我于今年（2026 年）5 月从芝加哥洛约拉大学毕业，获得金融学学位。

sents.en: I also spent four different summers working at a large healthcare company as a Financial Planning and Analysis Intern.
sents.zh: 我还连续四个暑假在一家大型医疗健康公司担任财务规划与分析实习生。

sents.en: Despite how amazing those experiences were, they also made me feel like my fate had already been decided, fostering an unhealthy perspective where careers outside of my “one-way path” were a waste of all the time I had invested.
sents.zh: 尽管这些经历非常美好，但它们也让我觉得自己的命运早已注定，养成了一种不健康的心态，认为偏离这条“单行道”的任何职业道路，都是对我投入的所有时间的一种浪费。

paragraphs.en: However, that short-sighted mindset rapidly changed within my final semesters of school and blossomed into what I’d call a major pivot for the better - all because I started teaching myself a software I’d never touched in my life.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，这种短视的心态在我学期的最后几个学期里迅速改变，并发展成我称之为一次重大转折的向好转变——这一切都源于我开始自学一款我从未接触过的软件。

paragraphs.en: I’ve been an entrepreneur for as long as I can remember, with random side-hustles ever since I was in elementary school. From sneaker reselling, dropshipping massage guns, rug tufting, rainbow-loom bracelets, you name it, I’ve probably done it.
paragraphs.zh: 从我记事起，我就一直是个创业者，从小学时代起就搞各种五花八门的副业。 从倒卖球鞋、代发货按摩枪、簇绒地毯编织，到彩虹织机手链，你能想到的我可能都做过。

sents.en: I’ve been an entrepreneur for as long as I can remember, with random side-hustles ever since I was in elementary school.
sents.zh: 从我记事起，我就一直是个创业者，从小学时代起就搞各种五花八门的副业。

sents.en: From sneaker reselling, dropshipping massage guns, rug tufting, rainbow-loom bracelets, you name it, I’ve probably done it.
sents.zh: 从倒卖球鞋、代发货按摩枪、簇绒地毯编织，到彩虹织机手链，你能想到的我可能都做过。

paragraphs.en: The newest one I stumbled into during my final semesters at Loyola was workflow automation in n8n. That was the first time I truly flexed the stupidity muscle, activated by operating outside my ol’ reliable set of finance/quant knowledge that I frequently relied on and rarely had the courage to step away from.
paragraphs.zh: 我在洛约拉大学最后一个学期偶然接触到的新东西，是 n8n 中的工作流自动化。 那是我第一次真正施展“愚蠢”这项能力——走出我一直依赖、也几乎没勇气离开的那套金融/量化知识的舒适区，才被激发出来的。

sents.en: The newest one I stumbled into during my final semesters at Loyola was workflow automation in n8n.
sents.zh: 我在洛约拉大学最后一个学期偶然接触到的新东西，是 n8n 中的工作流自动化。

sents.en: That was the first time I truly flexed the stupidity muscle, activated by operating outside my ol’ reliable set of finance/quant knowledge that I frequently relied on and rarely had the courage to step away from.
sents.zh: 那是我第一次真正施展“愚蠢”这项能力——走出我一直依赖、也几乎没勇气离开的那套金融/量化知识的舒适区，才被激发出来的。

paragraphs.en: I’d heard about the software from social media, fellow entrepreneurs, and other productivity creators I follow. All were saying the same things: it improved business processes, multiplied productivity, offered passive income opportunities (the classic), and more. So like any easily influenced college student, I jumped on the hype train.
paragraphs.zh: 我是从社交媒体、其他创业者朋友，以及我关注的其他效率类创作者那里听说这款软件的。 他们说的都是同样的话：它改善了业务流程、成倍提升了生产力、提供了被动收入机会（经典的宣传点），等等。 于是，像任何容易受影响的大学新生一样，我跳上了这趟炒作列车。

sents.en: I’d heard about the software from social media, fellow entrepreneurs, and other productivity creators I follow.
sents.zh: 我是从社交媒体、其他创业者朋友，以及我关注的其他效率类创作者那里听说这款软件的。

sents.en: All were saying the same things: it improved business processes, multiplied productivity, offered passive income opportunities (the classic), and more.
sents.zh: 他们说的都是同样的话：它改善了业务流程、成倍提升了生产力、提供了被动收入机会（经典的宣传点），等等。

sents.en: So like any easily influenced college student, I jumped on the hype train.
sents.zh: 于是，像任何容易受影响的大学新生一样，我跳上了这趟炒作列车。

paragraphs.en: My original plan was to just automate the tasks that felt redundant in my schoolwork, career search, investment research, and basic day-to-day tasks. Then, I’d later pair my automations with the analytical capabilities of AI agents once I first felt comfortable making workflows that didn’t involve AI - all with hopes to create the foundation of a decent business.
paragraphs.zh: 我最初的计划只是把学校作业、求职、投资研究以及一些日常事务中那些感觉重复繁琐的任务自动化。 然后，等我先对构建不涉及 AI 的工作流感到得心应手之后，再为我的自动化流程配上 AI 智能体的分析能力——这一切都是希望为打造一家像样的企业奠定基础。

sents.en: My original plan was to just automate the tasks that felt redundant in my schoolwork, career search, investment research, and basic day-to-day tasks.
sents.zh: 我最初的计划只是把学校作业、求职、投资研究以及一些日常事务中那些感觉重复繁琐的任务自动化。

sents.en: Then, I’d later pair my automations with the analytical capabilities of AI agents once I first felt comfortable making workflows that didn’t involve AI - all with hopes to create the foundation of a decent business.
sents.zh: 然后，等我先对构建不涉及 AI 的工作流感到得心应手之后，再为我的自动化流程配上 AI 智能体的分析能力——这一切都是希望为打造一家像样的企业奠定基础。

paragraphs.en: I signed up, opened it, and was met with a blank canvas with access to hundreds of random nodes, triggers, and inputs to choose from that I had no idea how to use.
paragraphs.zh: 我注册并打开它，映入眼帘的是一块空白画布，上面有数百个随机节点、触发器和输入可供选择，而我完全不知道该如何使用它们。

paragraphs.en: The first thing n8n shows on a fresh flow:
paragraphs.zh: n8n 在新建流程时展示的第一件事：

paragraphs.en: Starting with that blank canvas after being bombarded with colossal workflows that took up entire canvases made me question my limited skill-set and if it was even possible for me to do the same thing with no technical experience of any kind.
paragraphs.zh: 在被那些占满整个画布的庞大工作流轰炸之后，面对一块空白画布，我不禁怀疑自己有限的技能，怀疑在没有任何技术经验的情况下，我是否也能做到同样的事情。

paragraphs.en: These were a few of the questions I asked myself after opening that first canvas and wondering if it was even possible for me to catch up to those that had been working with the system for YEARS:
paragraphs.zh: 这就是我打开第一块画布后问自己的几个问题，当时我不禁怀疑，对于已经使用该系统工作「多年」的人来说，自己是否还有可能追赶上他们：

paragraphs.en: “Wow, I’m stupid” is what I told myself, all because I didn’t miraculously know what to build first, or what workflow could “revolutionize my productivity” like forum writers and “experts” had claimed. As silly as it sounds, I felt pretty down during my start because it completely exposed how little I knew about basic topics in the technical world. Especially ones that were considered second nature to those more experienced than I, and frequently used in workflows I’d seen. Even with the fact I was just starting out - I, for some reason, still expected myself to figure it all out then and there.
paragraphs.zh: “哇，我真笨”——我就是这样对自己说的，全都是因为我没有奇迹般地知道该先构建什么，或者什么工作流能像论坛写手和“专家”所声称的那样“彻底革新我的生产力”。 尽管听起来很傻，但我在起步阶段确实相当沮丧，因为这完全暴露了我对技术领域的基础知识了解得多么少。 尤其是那些对比我更有经验的人来说如同第二天性、并且在我见过的工作流中经常用到的东西。 即便我才刚刚起步——不知为何，我仍然期望自己当场就把一切都搞明白。

sents.en: “Wow, I’m stupid” is what I told myself, all because I didn’t miraculously know what to build first, or what workflow could “revolutionize my productivity” like forum writers and “experts” had claimed.
sents.zh: “哇，我真笨”——我就是这样对自己说的，全都是因为我没有奇迹般地知道该先构建什么，或者什么工作流能像论坛写手和“专家”所声称的那样“彻底革新我的生产力”。

sents.en: As silly as it sounds, I felt pretty down during my start because it completely exposed how little I knew about basic topics in the technical world.
sents.zh: 尽管听起来很傻，但我在起步阶段确实相当沮丧，因为这完全暴露了我对技术领域的基础知识了解得多么少。

sents.en: Especially ones that were considered second nature to those more experienced than I, and frequently used in workflows I’d seen.
sents.zh: 尤其是那些对比我更有经验的人来说如同第二天性、并且在我见过的工作流中经常用到的东西。

sents.en: Even with the fact I was just starting out - I, for some reason, still expected myself to figure it all out then and there.
sents.zh: 即便我才刚刚起步——不知为何，我仍然期望自己当场就把一切都搞明白。

paragraphs.en: I realized in that moment and admitted to myself: This wasn’t a part of my pre-programmed script. My first instinct was to quit and cancel the subscription to save myself from the disappointment, but I replaced my desires to quit with the mindset:
paragraphs.zh: 我在那一刻意识到，并向自己承认：这并不在我预先编好的剧本之中。 我的第一反应是退出并取消订阅，以免自己陷入失望，但我把想要退出的念头换成了这样一种心态：

sents.en: I realized in that moment and admitted to myself: This wasn’t a part of my pre-programmed script.
sents.zh: 我在那一刻意识到，并向自己承认：这并不在我预先编好的剧本之中。

sents.en: My first instinct was to quit and cancel the subscription to save myself from the disappointment, but I replaced my desires to quit with the mindset:
sents.zh: 我的第一反应是退出并取消订阅，以免自己陷入失望，但我把想要退出的念头换成了这样一种心态：

paragraphs.en: This was my own little way of creating a wake-up call to remind myself I was fully capable of building something useful and had the ability to do exactly as I had planned as long as I put in the work.
paragraphs.zh: 这是我自己的小小方式，为自己敲响警钟，提醒我完全有能力构建一些有用的东西，并且只要付出努力，就有能力完全按照自己的计划去做。

paragraphs.en: Now saying “just figure it out dude” isn’t a magic cure that can be used for everything in life, but when it comes to doing hard things without reasonable motivation or comforting amounts of experience - sometimes you need that wake-up call to keep you on track.
paragraphs.zh: 现在，说一句“老兄，自己想办法吧”并不是万能灵药，不能解决生活中的一切问题，但在缺乏合理动机或足够经验去完成困难的事情时——有时候你正需要这样一记当头棒喝，来让自己保持在正轨上。

paragraphs.en: I spent weeks scavenging Reddit posts, Medium articles, and reviewing YouTube guides to learn as much as possible from those that knew more than I did. But looking back, I honestly have regrets with how much time I invested in doing that. I learned that there’s only so much I could gain from just watching videos and reading before getting stuck in what I call tutorial limbo - where I’d spend never-ending amounts of time watching others and researching random questions instead of actually doing .
paragraphs.zh: 我花了几周时间翻阅 Reddit 帖子、Medium 文章，还看了不少 YouTube 教程，尽可能地从那些比我懂行的人那里学习。 但回头看，我真心后悔在那些事情上投入了那么多时间。 我意识到，光看视频和阅读能学到的东西终究有限，很快就会陷入我所说的“教程炼狱”——无休止地花时间看别人操作、研究各种零散问题，而不是真正动手去做。

sents.en: I spent weeks scavenging Reddit posts, Medium articles, and reviewing YouTube guides to learn as much as possible from those that knew more than I did.
sents.zh: 我花了几周时间翻阅 Reddit 帖子、Medium 文章，还看了不少 YouTube 教程，尽可能地从那些比我懂行的人那里学习。

sents.en: But looking back, I honestly have regrets with how much time I invested in doing that.
sents.zh: 但回头看，我真心后悔在那些事情上投入了那么多时间。

sents.en: I learned that there’s only so much I could gain from just watching videos and reading before getting stuck in what I call tutorial limbo - where I’d spend never-ending amounts of time watching others and researching random questions instead of actually doing .
sents.zh: 我意识到，光看视频和阅读能学到的东西终究有限，很快就会陷入我所说的“教程炼狱”——无休止地花时间看别人操作、研究各种零散问题，而不是真正动手去做。

paragraphs.en: I feel that tutorials and informative reading are always good starting points for getting down the basics of a skill. However, I realized getting to a point where you reap the benefits from what you’re hoping to learn requires you to do it yourself and fail. A lot.
paragraphs.zh: 我觉得教程和知识性读物始终是掌握一门技能基础知识的好起点。 然而，我意识到，要想真正从你想学的东西中获益，就必须亲自去实践并经历失败。而且是大量失败。

sents.en: I feel that tutorials and informative reading are always good starting points for getting down the basics of a skill.
sents.zh: 我觉得教程和知识性读物始终是掌握一门技能基础知识的好起点。

sents.en: However, I realized getting to a point where you reap the benefits from what you’re hoping to learn requires you to do it yourself and fail. A lot.
sents.zh: 然而，我意识到，要想真正从你想学的东西中获益，就必须亲自去实践并经历失败。而且是大量失败。

paragraphs.en: This naturally resulted in me feeling stupid a lot .
paragraphs.zh: 这自然导致我经常感到自己很蠢。

paragraphs.en: I’ve been a victim of tutorial limbo myself because it honestly feels amazing to think you’re learning a new skill. The dopamine rush from all things shiny and envisioning yourself replicating content you’re reading/watching - it’s addicting. Regardless, the heartbreaking reality is that it’s rarely ever productive. I’m still learning to avoid falling into that void to this day.
paragraphs.zh: 我自己也曾是“教程泥潭”的受害者，因为说实话，感觉自己在学习一项新技能真的很令人愉悦。 各种新鲜事物带来的多巴胺刺激，以及想象自己能够复刻正在阅读/观看的内容——这着实令人上瘾。 然而残酷的现实是，这几乎很少有什么实际产出。 时至今日，我也仍在学习如何避免陷入那个虚空之中。

sents.en: I’ve been a victim of tutorial limbo myself because it honestly feels amazing to think you’re learning a new skill.
sents.zh: 我自己也曾是“教程泥潭”的受害者，因为说实话，感觉自己在学习一项新技能真的很令人愉悦。

sents.en: The dopamine rush from all things shiny and envisioning yourself replicating content you’re reading/watching - it’s addicting.
sents.zh: 各种新鲜事物带来的多巴胺刺激，以及想象自己能够复刻正在阅读/观看的内容——这着实令人上瘾。

sents.en: Regardless, the heartbreaking reality is that it’s rarely ever productive.
sents.zh: 然而残酷的现实是，这几乎很少有什么实际产出。

sents.en: I’m still learning to avoid falling into that void to this day.
sents.zh: 时至今日，我也仍在学习如何避免陷入那个虚空之中。

paragraphs.en: The most damaging action, though, was actively exposing myself to the best outcomes the skill had to offer that were only possible with months or even years of experience.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，最具破坏性的举动，是主动让自己接触到该技能所能提供的最佳成果，而这些成果只有经过数月甚至数年的经验才可能实现。

paragraphs.en: While in the process of learning, it’s by far been the biggest trap and motivation killer I’ve experienced. It’s fine observing what’s possible with a skill, but never overdo it to the point where you paralyze yourself with doubt like I did. Especially in the age of social media larping , you never know who’s just straight up lying for attention, profit, or in an active hunt for new victims to buy their snake-oil-esque course.
paragraphs.zh: 在学习的过程中，这绝对是我经历过的最大的陷阱和动力杀手。 观察一项技能能实现什么固然没问题，但千万不要过度，以免像我一样陷入怀疑而让自己动弹不得。 尤其是在社交媒体上装腔作势的时代，你永远不知道谁在纯粹为了博取关注、牟利，或是为了 actively 寻找新的受害者来购买他们那种蛇油式的课程而撒谎。

sents.en: While in the process of learning, it’s by far been the biggest trap and motivation killer I’ve experienced.
sents.zh: 在学习的过程中，这绝对是我经历过的最大的陷阱和动力杀手。

sents.en: It’s fine observing what’s possible with a skill, but never overdo it to the point where you paralyze yourself with doubt like I did.
sents.zh: 观察一项技能能实现什么固然没问题，但千万不要过度，以免像我一样陷入怀疑而让自己动弹不得。

sents.en: Especially in the age of social media larping , you never know who’s just straight up lying for attention, profit, or in an active hunt for new victims to buy their snake-oil-esque course.
sents.zh: 尤其是在社交媒体上装腔作势的时代，你永远不知道谁在纯粹为了博取关注、牟利，或是为了 actively 寻找新的受害者来购买他们那种蛇油式的课程而撒谎。

paragraphs.en: What I’ve found to actually be productive was starting small and “just doing.” Specifically, seeking out mistakes within MY way of work to actually learn what worked for ME.
paragraphs.zh: 我发现真正有效的方法是从小处着手并“直接去做”。具体来说，就是在自己的工作方式中寻找错误，从而真正了解什么对我是有效的。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, reminding myself that the ability to even start was an accomplishment in itself. Many never make it out of the limbo loop in the first place, so starting has always been a win in my book. So many past interests of mine carry hours that went into googling and asking people “how do I get better at ___,” instead of actually doing what it took to figure it out for myself.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，我提醒自己：能够着手开始，这本身就是一种成就。 许多人从一开始就未能走出那种悬而未决的循环，所以在我看来，开始行动始终是一场胜利。 我的许多过往兴趣都伴随着大量耗费在谷歌搜索和询问他人「我该如何在___方面做得更好」上的时间，而不是真正动手去做、自己去摸索出答案。

sents.en: Furthermore, reminding myself that the ability to even start was an accomplishment in itself.
sents.zh: 此外，我提醒自己：能够着手开始，这本身就是一种成就。

sents.en: Many never make it out of the limbo loop in the first place, so starting has always been a win in my book.
sents.zh: 许多人从一开始就未能走出那种悬而未决的循环，所以在我看来，开始行动始终是一场胜利。

sents.en: So many past interests of mine carry hours that went into googling and asking people “how do I get better at ___,” instead of actually doing what it took to figure it out for myself.
sents.zh: 我的许多过往兴趣都伴随着大量耗费在谷歌搜索和询问他人「我该如何在___方面做得更好」上的时间，而不是真正动手去做、自己去摸索出答案。

paragraphs.en: Wasted potential survives and feasts on those stuck in the limbo loop.
paragraphs.zh: 被浪费的潜力得以存续，并以困于循环炼狱中的那些人为食。

paragraphs.en: Nobody comes out of the womb sprinting full speed (hats off if you did). You need to learn to crawl first, and my first time crawling was a simple workflow that sent me a Slack notification when I received an email response about a job I applied for at Google.
paragraphs.zh: 没有人一出生就能全速奔跑（如果你能做到，那真要脱帽致敬）。 你需要先学会爬行，而我第一次“爬行”是一个简单的工作流：当我收到关于我在 Google 申请职位的邮件回复时，它会给我发送一条 Slack 通知。

sents.en: Nobody comes out of the womb sprinting full speed (hats off if you did).
sents.zh: 没有人一出生就能全速奔跑（如果你能做到，那真要脱帽致敬）。

sents.en: You need to learn to crawl first, and my first time crawling was a simple workflow that sent me a Slack notification when I received an email response about a job I applied for at Google.
sents.zh: 你需要先学会爬行，而我第一次“爬行”是一个简单的工作流：当我收到关于我在 Google 申请职位的邮件回复时，它会给我发送一条 Slack 通知。

paragraphs.en: I spent the first day attempting to wire the trigger to my Xfinity email as a first test for random emails - only for it to never work.
paragraphs.zh: 我花了第一天时间尝试将触发器连接到我的 Xfinity 邮箱，作为对随机邮件的首次测试——结果它始终无法正常工作。

paragraphs.en: So my first day was spent not even making it past a trigger node while getting sidetracked by YouTube limbo waving all kinds of “My n8n AI Agent that ___ for me” carrots in my face.
paragraphs.zh: 所以我的第一天甚至没能通过一个触发节点，期间还被 YouTube 上各种挥舞着“我的 n8n AI 智能体替我___”的胡萝卜引诱得频频分心。

paragraphs.en: But the next day was where I triumphed; I learned about the basics of API keys and their use-cases. I finally integrated my Gmail and Slack APIs, and had a functional flow in no time.
paragraphs.zh: 但第二天才是我大显身手的时候；我学习了 API 密钥的基础知识及其使用场景。 我终于集成了我的 Gmail 和 Slack API，并很快搭建出了一个可正常运行的流程。

sents.en: But the next day was where I triumphed; I learned about the basics of API keys and their use-cases.
sents.zh: 但第二天才是我大显身手的时候；我学习了 API 密钥的基础知识及其使用场景。

sents.en: I finally integrated my Gmail and Slack APIs, and had a functional flow in no time.
sents.zh: 我终于集成了我的 Gmail 和 Slack API，并很快搭建出了一个可正常运行的流程。

paragraphs.en: All it took was me sending every error msg I got from each node to Gemini and googling “what does error ___ mean in n8n” or “how to fix error ___ n8n” a billion times.
paragraphs.zh: 我所做的只是把每个节点收到的每一条错误信息发给 Gemini，再加上无数次谷歌搜索“错误 ___ 在 n8n 中是什么意思”或“如何修复 n8n 中的错误 ___”。

paragraphs.en: This is the hand-holding I was doing that made me feel the most stupid. But as a result of those errors, it also turned into an important lesson surrounding data/string formatting without me even knowing.
paragraphs.zh: 这就是我之前所做的“手把手引导”，也是让我感觉自己最愚蠢的部分。 但由于这些错误，它也在我不知不觉中变成了关于数据/字符串格式化的重要一课。

sents.en: This is the hand-holding I was doing that made me feel the most stupid.
sents.zh: 这就是我之前所做的“手把手引导”，也是让我感觉自己最愚蠢的部分。

sents.en: But as a result of those errors, it also turned into an important lesson surrounding data/string formatting without me even knowing.
sents.zh: 但由于这些错误，它也在我不知不觉中变成了关于数据/字符串格式化的重要一课。

paragraphs.en: Can this easily be done by setting up notification preferences in the careers page? Absolutely. But who cares? The point was to start and make something that worked - and this workflow did exactly that. I got the notification of my rejection to the job in a timely fashion to my Slack with green execution signals next to it. Success .
paragraphs.zh: 这件事其实通过在招聘页面设置通知偏好就能轻松完成？当然可以。但谁在乎呢？ 重点在于动手做出一个能用的东西——而这个工作流恰恰做到了这一点。 我被拒的通知及时发送到了我的 Slack，旁边还显示着绿色执行成功信号。成功了。

sents.en: Can this easily be done by setting up notification preferences in the careers page? Absolutely. But who cares?
sents.zh: 这件事其实通过在招聘页面设置通知偏好就能轻松完成？当然可以。但谁在乎呢？

sents.en: The point was to start and make something that worked - and this workflow did exactly that.
sents.zh: 重点在于动手做出一个能用的东西——而这个工作流恰恰做到了这一点。

sents.en: I got the notification of my rejection to the job in a timely fashion to my Slack with green execution signals next to it. Success .
sents.zh: 我被拒的通知及时发送到了我的 Slack，旁边还显示着绿色执行成功信号。成功了。

paragraphs.en: From then on, pretty much Monday - Sunday I spent my free time making random workflows with nodes I’d never used before on purpose just for the sake of improving. Slowly but surely after two months of never looking at automation content outside of error resolution, and breaking things every day - I became more advanced with what I was making.
paragraphs.zh: 从那以后，几乎周一到周日，我把空闲时间都用来故意使用那些从未用过的节点制作各种随机工作流，纯粹是为了提升自己。 慢慢地，在两个月里除了排错之外不看任何自动化相关内容、并且每天都在弄坏东西之后——我做的智能体工作流变得越来越高级了。

sents.en: From then on, pretty much Monday - Sunday I spent my free time making random workflows with nodes I’d never used before on purpose just for the sake of improving.
sents.zh: 从那以后，几乎周一到周日，我把空闲时间都用来故意使用那些从未用过的节点制作各种随机工作流，纯粹是为了提升自己。

sents.en: Slowly but surely after two months of never looking at automation content outside of error resolution, and breaking things every day - I became more advanced with what I was making.
sents.zh: 慢慢地，在两个月里除了排错之外不看任何自动化相关内容、并且每天都在弄坏东西之后——我做的智能体工作流变得越来越高级了。

paragraphs.en: Here are a few of the “advanced” flows I came to create during my last semester:
paragraphs.zh: 以下是我上个学期创建的一些「高级」流程：

paragraphs.en: These workflows are a small sample of the hundreds that I made over the span of my last semester, and almost 50% of the stuff I made either didn’t work, was dropped, or had no real use-case that benefitted me.
paragraphs.zh: 这些工作流只是我上学期制作的数百个中的一个小样本，其中近 50% 的东西要么无法运行，要么被放弃，要么没有能让我受益的实际使用场景。

paragraphs.en: I also didn’t even realize n8n had an MCP server and API that could be used to create workflows with AI agents that utilized best practices until I was TWO MONTHS IN.
paragraphs.zh: 我甚至直到两个月后（TWO MONTHS IN）才意识到，n8n 还有一个 MCP 服务器和 API，可以用来与采用最佳实践的智能体（AI agents）一起创建工作流。

paragraphs.en: Probably the sole reason why none of my early stuff worked lol
paragraphs.zh: 可能这就是我早期的东西全都失败的唯一原因吧 哈哈

paragraphs.en: But because of that delayed realization, I learned so much about myself and things I never imagined I had a passion for. Just from this experience, I was able to learn and utilize in new projects of mine:
paragraphs.zh: 但正是因为这种后知后觉，我更加深刻地认识了自己，并发现了许多我从未想过自己会热爱的东西。 仅仅通过这次经历，我就学到了很多，并将其运用到了我的新项目中：

sents.zh: 但正是因为这种后知后觉，我更加深刻地认识了自己，并发现了许多我从未想过自己会热爱的东西。

sents.en: Just from this experience, I was able to learn and utilize in new projects of mine:
sents.zh: 仅仅通过这次经历，我就学到了很多，并将其运用到了我的新项目中：

paragraphs.en: Those are just a few topics I can name off the top of my head, and reading that list as I type this makes me feel so proud of myself. I never envisioned myself coming this far with topics I literally knew nothing about (and honestly still don’t) after having that one-way street mindset before starting. It’s sparked numerous new passions, business opportunities, and connections I never imagined myself having a year ago.
paragraphs.zh: 这些只是我随口就能说出的几个话题，一边打字一边看着这份清单，我为自己感到无比自豪。 在开始之前我抱着单行道的思维定式，从没想过自己能走这么远，涉足那些我原本一无所知的话题（说实话，现在也谈不上精通）。 它激发了许多新的热情、商业机会和人脉 connections，这些在一年前是我想都不敢想的。

paragraphs.en: If I could give anyone a piece of advice from my personal experience of always looking to learn new things, it would be:
paragraphs.zh: 如果基于我个人一直乐于学习新事物的经验，我能给任何人一条建议的话，那就是：

paragraphs.en: The hardest part about this process was easily starting. More so than dealing with the failures and disappointments. Looking back, there were numerous factors that played a role in what kept me from doing so:
paragraphs.zh: 这个过程中最难的部分无疑是开始。 甚至比面对失败和失望更难。 回头看，有许多因素阻碍了我开始行动：

sents.en: The hardest part about this process was easily starting.
sents.zh: 这个过程中最难的部分无疑是开始。

sents.en: More so than dealing with the failures and disappointments.
sents.zh: 甚至比面对失败和失望更难。

sents.en: Looking back, there were numerous factors that played a role in what kept me from doing so:
sents.zh: 回头看，有许多因素阻碍了我开始行动：

paragraphs.en: Progress didn’t happen until I stopped exposing myself to insight and content that held no value to me or my journey.
paragraphs.zh: 直到我停止接触那些对我或我的旅程毫无价值的洞见和内容，进步才真正发生。

paragraphs.en: Too often we’re fed advice and input from sources that aren’t worth listening to, and even if they are worth listening to - their advice isn’t universal or applicable. I’m not saying to ignore all advice or practical norms, but when trying to improve any aspect of yourself, everything you consume matters. If you choose to consume external input, make sure it’s the right stuff that applies. Nothing compares to learning what works for you , and if you spend too much time consuming what works for others, you’ll never become the best version of yourself.
paragraphs.zh: 我们常常接收到的建议和信息来自不值得倾听的来源，即使这些来源值得倾听——他们的建议也不具备普适性或适用性。 我不是说要在意所有建议或实用规范，但当你在努力提升自己的任何一个方面时，你消费的每一样东西都很重要。 如果你选择接收外部输入，请确保它是适用的、正确的内容。 没有什么比弄清楚什么对你有效更重要，如果你把太多时间花在接收对别人有效的内容上，你将永远无法成为最好的自己。

paragraphs.en: Turning away from the void sucked. I had no shiny carrot to chase and I realized I knew nothing. But in the end it paid off 10x more than I expected.
paragraphs.zh: 转身逃避空虚的感觉很糟糕。 我没有闪亮的胡萝卜可以追逐，而且我意识到自己一无所知。 但最终它的回报超出了我的预期十倍。

sents.en: Turning away from the void sucked.

sents.en: I had no shiny carrot to chase and I realized I knew nothing.

sents.en: But in the end it paid off 10x more than I expected.
sents.zh: 但最终它的回报超出了我的预期十倍。

paragraphs.en: Fast-forward to present day, and the lessons I learned started to spill into my life for the better. The practice I gained with scripting within code and filter nodes led to numerous business ventures powered by agentic coding, all of which I operated as a student.
paragraphs.zh: 快进到今天，我学到的这些经验开始对我的生活产生积极的影响。 我在代码和过滤器节点中编写脚本所积累的实践，催生了众多由智能体编程驱动的商业项目，而这些都是我在学生时代运营的。

sents.en: Fast-forward to present day, and the lessons I learned started to spill into my life for the better.
sents.zh: 快进到今天，我学到的这些经验开始对我的生活产生积极的影响。

sents.en: The practice I gained with scripting within code and filter nodes led to numerous business ventures powered by agentic coding, all of which I operated as a student.
sents.zh: 我在代码和过滤器节点中编写脚本所积累的实践，催生了众多由智能体编程驱动的商业项目，而这些都是我在学生时代运营的。

paragraphs.en: My effort to balance the nonstop ideas I had from my newfound passion across programming, solving problems with data, and raw hunger to just build eventually led to me developing my biggest project yet. That project and its MVP eventually landed me early-stage acceptance into Chicago’s #1 tech incubator . Being surrounded by some of the brightest minds in my own backyard with the ability to learn from them without judgment has pushed me beyond what I ever thought was possible for myself.
paragraphs.zh: 我努力平衡自己因新燃起的热情而产生的源源不断的想法——涵盖编程、用数据解决问题，以及纯粹想要构建东西的强烈渴望——最终促成了我迄今最大的项目的诞生。 那个项目及其 MVP（最小可行产品）最终让我获得了芝加哥第一大科技孵化器的早期入驻资格。 在自己身边被一群最聪明的头脑包围，并能毫无顾虑地向他们学习，这推动我超越了自己曾以为可能的极限。

sents.en: My effort to balance the nonstop ideas I had from my newfound passion across programming, solving problems with data, and raw hunger to just build eventually led to me developing my biggest project yet.
sents.zh: 我努力平衡自己因新燃起的热情而产生的源源不断的想法——涵盖编程、用数据解决问题，以及纯粹想要构建东西的强烈渴望——最终促成了我迄今最大的项目的诞生。

sents.en: That project and its MVP eventually landed me early-stage acceptance into Chicago’s #1 tech incubator .
sents.zh: 那个项目及其 MVP（最小可行产品）最终让我获得了芝加哥第一大科技孵化器的早期入驻资格。

sents.en: Being surrounded by some of the brightest minds in my own backyard with the ability to learn from them without judgment has pushed me beyond what I ever thought was possible for myself.
sents.zh: 在自己身边被一群最聪明的头脑包围，并能毫无顾虑地向他们学习，这推动我超越了自己曾以为可能的极限。

paragraphs.en: Avenues that didn’t exist a year ago for me only came after I made the decision to be content with feeling stupid, and I hope anyone reading this feels more motivated to do the same.
paragraphs.zh: 一些一年前对我来说根本不存在的途径，是在我下定决心接受“感觉自己很蠢”之后才出现的。我希望读到这篇文章的任何人都能更有动力去做同样的事情。

paragraphs.en: Maybe my own advice isn’t worth listening to either. But nonetheless, I truly hope everyone reading this can experience the same thrill I’ve been feeling since I started being content with stupidity.
paragraphs.zh: 也许我自己的建议也不值得听。 但尽管如此，我真心希望每一位读到这篇文章的人，都能体验到自从我学会满足于愚钝以来一直感受到的那种兴奋。

sents.zh: 也许我自己的建议也不值得听。
